title: Jade Dragon: The Golden Pearl
prompt:
Create one premium game catalogue cover image, landscape exactly 2:1 aspect ratio. This is a production thumbnail for the existing fantasy slot game Jade Dragon: The Golden Pearl. It must read beautifully at 384 by 192 pixels.
A magnificent emerald Chinese dragon curves along the left side and upper corner of a deep jade palace scene; a luminous iridescent golden pearl floats near the lower center. Misty mountains, a hint of a distant lantern-lit pagoda, delicate gold cloud engraving, rich lacquered greens and restrained antique gold, with a warm cinematic glow. Match an elegant, polished high-end 3D game-art style; refined, magical and inviting.
The title is the dominant focal point in the central safe area: exact large lettering "JADE DRAGON" in a beautifully substantial gold engraved serif, with exact smaller subtitle "THE GOLDEN PEARL". High contrast and exceptional small-size legibility. Leave comfortable clear space around the text; keep title and pearl within the middle 80 percent so the cover can crop safely. Dragon detail must not crowd or obscure the lettering.
The result is finished edge-to-edge artwork for a game card, not a mockup board. No cabinet, no reels, no buttons, no browser chrome, no border, no extra wording, no promotional claims, no watermark.

visualCheck.fullSize: Jade Dragon title and Golden Pearl subtitle are legible; the jade dragon and pearl match the game theme.
visualCheck.thumbnail: Wide title-card composition keeps the title and dragon visible at catalogue size.
visualCheck.compression: 768 by 384 WebP, 103350 bytes; below the 180 KB runtime limit.
